title: More Bounce
description: This mod adds many new bouncy balls to minecraft for example the house ball spawns a ball wherever it lands its a fun goofy mod that  you can add to your sever for more fun. This mod is to help minecraft on expanding there balls for not just having snowbal
body: This mod has all the balls you need red ones blue ones and even spider ones. This is my first mod I made it has like 30+ balls all speical with crafting recipies! I hope you guys enjoy and its pretty cool to mess around with them. The purpose for this mod was to add bouncyballs to minecraft This mod is not for sexual purposes and truly is just about bouncy balls and new types of balls to minecraft
